issues.en: Roads: 92 roads of Katehari were put in the district plan to repair broken roads (Jan 2025).
issues.hi: सड़कें: ज़िले की टूटी सड़कों की मरम्मत योजना में कटेहरी की 92 सड़कें शामिल की गईं (जनवरी 2025)।

issues.en: Voter list revision (SIR): in Dec 2025 about 2.5 lakh enumeration forms were still pending across the district.
issues.hi: मतदाता सूची पुनरीक्षण (SIR): दिसंबर 2025 में ज़िले में करीब 2.5 लाख गणना फ़ॉर्म बाकी थे।

issues.en: The district published a list of Katehari voters flagged for 'no mapping / logical discrepancy' during SIR.
issues.hi: ज़िले ने SIR के दौरान 'मैपिंग नहीं / तार्किक गड़बड़ी' वाले कटेहरी के मतदाताओं की सूची जारी की।

issues.en: Ghaghra erosion: an anti-erosion scheme was sanctioned for Ambedkar Nagar district (not specific to Katehari).
issues.hi: घाघरा कटान: अम्बेडकर नगर ज़िले के लिए कटान-रोधी योजना मंज़ूर (सिर्फ़ कटेहरी के लिए नहीं)।

plan: Days 1–30: match booth workers to the 2026 polling-station list; help eligible people file Form 6/7/8 in the claims period; name a booth committee.
दिन 1–30: बूथ कार्यकर्ताओं को 2026 की मतदेय स्थल सूची से मिलाएँ; दावा-आपत्ति के समय पात्र लोगों के फ़ॉर्म 6/7/8 भरवाने में मदद; बूथ समिति तय करें।
Days 31–60: committees in all 474 booths, swing-lead and can-be-flipped booths first; listening meetings tola by tola; women's meetings.
दिन 31–60: सभी 474 बूथों पर समिति, पहले स्विंग बढ़त और पलटने लायक बूथ; टोला-टोला बात सुनने की बैठकें; महिला बैठकें।
Days 61–90: door-to-door contact; one issue note per village; train polling agents (mock poll, Form 17C).
दिन 61–90: घर-घर संपर्क; हर गाँव का मुद्दा-नोट; पोलिंग एजेंट प्रशिक्षण (मॉक पोल, फ़ॉर्म 17C)।

Days 91–120: follow the model code of conduct; take permission for every meeting; an agent in every booth, two in the 15 closest booths; no vehicles, money or gifts for voters; label any AI-made video.
दिन 91–120: आचार संहिता का पालन; हर सभा की अनुमति; हर बूथ पर एजेंट, 15 सबसे कड़े बूथों पर दो; वोटर को वाहन, पैसा या उपहार नहीं; AI से बने वीडियो पर साफ़ लेबल।
takeaways: The seat changes hands: SP 2012, BSP 2017, SP 2022, BJP in the 2024 bye-election.
सीट हर बार बदलती है: 2012 सपा, 2017 बसपा, 2022 सपा, 2024 उपचुनाव भाजपा।
Assembly margins were thin: 2.7% in 2017 and 3.0% in 2022; the 2024 bye-election margin was 15.1%.
It is a three-way seat: BSP had 23.8% in 2022, 17.7% in the 2024 Lok Sabha and 18.2% in the bye-election.
यह तीन-तरफ़ा सीट है: बसपा को 2022 में 23.8%, 2024 लोकसभा में 17.7% और उपचुनाव में 18.2% वोट मिले।
The middle bands decide it: each big party had 110–144 booths it lost by under 100 votes in 2022.
फ़ैसला बीच के खानों में होता है: 2022 में हर बड़ी पार्टी 110–144 बूथ 100 से कम वोट से हारी।
The roll has changed: the 2026 draft list has 3,64,894 voters in 474 polling stations, 28,996 fewer voters than 2022.
सूची बदल गई है: 2026 की आलेख्य सूची में 474 मतदेय स्थलों पर 3,64,894 मतदाता, 2022 से 28,996 कम।
Women matter: more women than men voted in 332 of 464 booths in 2022.
महिलाएँ अहम हैं: 2022 में 464 में से 332 बूथों पर पुरुषों से ज़्यादा महिलाओं ने वोट डाला।
errors: Form-20 booth totals exclude postal ballots. Official 2022: Lalji Verma 93,524, Avadhesh Kumar 85,828, Prateek Pandey 58,482 (margin 7,696); booth sums here: 92,808 / 85,548 / 58,186 (margin 7,260). 2017 official winner 84,358 vs 84,049 here. All booth-level numbers in this dossier are EVM votes only.
VS2017 and VS2022: 'voters' (people who voted) exceed counted votes by 2,235 (2017) and 1,486 (2022) — likely rejected/test votes; not explained in the file.
LS files: the booth 'candidate_votes_total' column already includes NOTA; in the VS files it does not. The cross-checks handle both.

LS2024 Form-20 has no party, booth names, electors or turnout. Parties for Lalji Verma (SP), Ritesh Pandey (BJP) and Qamar Hayat (BSP) were added by name; small candidates remain '?'. 2024 turnout and women's share cannot be shown.
LS2014 candidate names include the party name in the name field (e.g. 'Hari Om Pandey Bharatiya Janata Party').
LS2019: one independent candidate's name is garbled (English text wrongly read as Kruti Dev): 'ज्ंपहंत त्ंउदपीवत …'.
VS2012 names are in brackets in the file, e.g. '(SHANKHALAL MANJHI)'; brackets removed here.
VS2017: NISHAD party is written 'NINSHAD' in the file; treated as NISHAD.

Booths were renumbered every election: 359 (2012), 384 (2017), 449 (LS2019), 464 (2022), 425 (LS2024), 474 (2026 draft). VS2022 booth names are in English with typos (PARIMARY, FIST, COLEEGE); only 275 of 464 booths could be traced to 2017 and 346 to the 2026 list. Core/swing and village figures are therefore on traced booths only.
2026 list: the 'area' column of this AC holds the separate-gate answer, not the area; one polling station has no 'for all/men/women' entry; no tehsil/block per booth.
Electors: 2026 draft list sum 3,64,894; Wikipedia infobox 3,94,267 (undated); district site says 425 polling stations (old, undated).
Lowest 2022 turnout: booths 81 (15.7%) and 80 (27.8%) at Tanda Taapeey Inter College, Vidyut Nagar — verify on ground before using.
Bye-election 2024 turnout percentage not found; only votes cast (2,28,434).
